bugs.name: Contributors chart drag to zoom leaves its date range unchanged
bugs.summary: The Contributors chart advertises drag to zoom, but a wide drag does not change the plot or displayed date range.
bugs.expected: Dragging within the chart should zoom the plotted date interval.
bugs.actual: After dragging across the plot, its axis and displayed range remained unchanged.
reproSteps: Sign in to Forgejo and open a repository with commits, then Activity > Contributors.
Note the displayed date range and the chart instruction to drag to zoom.
Drag horizontally across the plot and compare the axis and date range.
